stories.headline: Pearsall's Knee Gives Out for Good and Deebo Walks Back Into an Empty Claim
stories.read: Well pardner, the Niners went and cut their losses. Ricky Pearsall's PCL has been leakin' swelling since Week 4 of last fall, and John Lynch finally put him under the knife and on the shelf for the whole ride. That's a full season of throws lyin' unclaimed in one of the best offenses on the Trail. Deebo Samuel rode back into San Francisco on a one-year handshake and lines up opposite Mike Evans with Demarcus Robinson, and the saloon is still pricin' Deebo like a busted-down mare after his year in Washington. Doc's read: a fella who was eighteenth in his cut of the throws and ninth in yards after the catch just inherited a vacant claim in a Kyle Shanahan offense. Go stake it two rounds before your outfit remembers his name.

stories.headline: Jonathon Brooks Rides With the Ones in Buffalo and Nobody in Your League Is Watchin'
stories.read: Two years the man spent laid up, and now Dave Canales has him workin' alongside Chuba Hubbard with the first outfit for the preseason opener up in Buffalo. First padded practice he cut through the line, made an All-Pro linebacker grab at air, and picked up the sticks like he never took a spill. Hubbard's still the ranch hand who gets the reins first, that's plain, but the folks in Carolina are talkin' about a one-two punch by early season, and Brooks is the half with the burst and the pass-game value. He's goin' for pocket change in the back end of drafts. That's cheap gold, pardner. Grab the spare horse before he becomes the whole stable.

stories.headline: Alec Pierce Is About to Step Off the Sick Wagon Just in Time for Baltimore
stories.read: The Colts stashed their hundred-and-fourteen-million-dollar deep man on the PUP list after ankle surgery, and the herd promptly forgot he existed. GM says he's makin' great progress and ought to come off that list inside a week, which puts him on the range Week 1 against the Ravens. This is the fella who's been the league's best bomb-catcher two years runnin', close to twenty yards a haul. Doc's read: nothin' drops a price like a boot and a shrug, and nothin' raises it like a healthy scratch in a preseason game. Stake the claim now while the saloon still thinks he's laid up, because a deep threat with the money patch in his pocket wins you weeks all by himself.
